## Feature Request

**Before submitting:** Search existing issues first. Ensure your request isn't achievable via snippets or existing functionality.

### Problem Statement
Describe the specific problem or limitation you've encountered.

### Proposed Solution
Provide a clear description of your suggested implementation and how it would benefit multiple users.

### Alternatives Considered
What other solutions have you researched and why weren't they suitable?

### Additional Context
Include any relevant examples, documentation, or technical considerations.

---

### Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have verified this cannot be achieved through snippets, existing plugins, or current settings
- [ ] This feature would benefit multiple users and isn't just a personal convenience
- [ ] I understand feature requests depend on project priorities and maintainer capacity
- [ ] I have read: https://mikemcquaid.com/open-source-maintainers-owe-you-nothing/
